collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager has had the same falling dream three nights running: tell a friend about it, or ask the healer for help.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: For three nights in a row, (subject) has dreamed the same dream: (subject.he/she) is falling, from somewhere very high, and wakes with a jolt just before (subject.he/she) lands. (subject.He/she) is exhausted. (subject.He/she) is starting to dread going to sleep. This morning (friend) notices the dark circles under (subject.his/her) eyes.

choices.label: Ask the Healer for Something to Help

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (subject) tells (friend) about the dream. (friend) says (friend.he/she) used to have one where (friend.his/her) teeth fell out. (villager), another villager, joins in with one about being chased by a pig. By the end of breakfast everyone is sharing their worst dreams, and laughing, and (subject) feels a bit less alone with it. The dream comes back that night. It's a bit less frightening.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (subject) visits (healer), the healer, who gives (subject.him/her) a calming tea and says, honestly, that it might help and might not. "Dreams do as they like," says (healer). (subject) drinks the tea. That night (subject.he/she) dreams about falling again, but this time (subject.he/she) lands softly in a giant pile of leaves. (subject.He/she) wakes up laughing.
